sub_limits_waiting_notes: Both Indemnity and Benefit product. Critical Illness rider: 28-day survival period, ages 18-45 eligible. Maternity 48 months. Length of stay options: 5/10/unlimited days for inpatient.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Admission beyond 24 hours - up to Sum Insured with opted number of days (5/10/unlimited)
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Includes room rent, ICU, OT, fees, telemedicine, medicines, diagnostics, prosthetics. Booster Benefit increases SI 50% per claim-free year.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All Day Care procedures up to Sum Insured
day_care_treatments.notes: More than 2 hours; covers angiography, dialysis, radiotherapy, chemotherapy.

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured for inpatient hospitalization under AYUSH Hospital

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Up to amount specified in Schedule (Women Care Benefit - optional)

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Up to Base Sum Insured (Women Care Benefit - optional)

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Lump sum Rs.3,00,000 for 60 listed critical illnesses (optional rider)
critical_illness_cover.notes: Ages 18-45 eligible. 28-day survival period. Can only opt at inception. Pre-existing CI excluded.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Unlimited Refill (optional): 100% Base SI from first paid claim onwards, all subsequent claims in Policy Year (related + unrelated illness)

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Stay Fit Health Check-Up up to Rs.5,000 once per Policy Year (individual basis, 18+ adults)

copayment_trigger_notes: Optional 10% or 20% co-payment per Policy Schedule on each admissible claim.

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: Global Treatment (Women Care Benefit - optional): Planned In-patient care outside India up to Base SI

permanent_exclusions: Treatment outside India (covered as Global Treatment rider)
notable_exclusions_summary: Health Edge is flexible policy with extensive optional covers - Domestic Help Indemnity, Hospital Daily Cash, Accidental Death, Healing Benefit, Unlimited Refill (Anyone Illness Waiver), Vector Borne Fixed Benefit, 60-CI Critical Illness lump sum, OPD, Booster Benefit (50% SI), Women Care (Maternity/Newborn/IVF), Global Treatment. Base policy excludes maternity, infertility, refractive error, treatment outside India unless those riders opted.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA at network hospitals; reimbursement claims. Toll-free 18001021111. Process per Section G.B.II.b of policy wordings.
available_riders: Critical Illness Cover (60 CIs, lump sum Rs.3L)
Booster Benefit (50% SI per claim-free year)
